ModMetaData.name: Project GU: Living Cultivation
ModMetaData.author: Project GU
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld 1.7 (Waylith). Project GU 0.2.5 development build with persistent underground spirit springs, native Spirit Grass and Moon Orchid cultivation on primeval qi-rich soil, physical primeval stones, natural awakening that consumes mature Hope Gu, and a provisional developer-only individual Gu framework.
